rapport_notes: Warm, patient; handled a complex "partial move / staged home for sale" scenario well.

evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "if the move goes faster than what we have anticipated, then of course, you pay less" (clean hit) — other Save Your Ass lines not covered.

top_strength: Estimate anchor was specifically personalized to the exact items mentioned (the 75" TV, patio furniture, one-hour drive) rather than a generic range — genuinely consultative.
coaching_note: Explicit close ask landed and converted, but the call skipped the agenda/concerns question entirely — worth surfacing given this customer was juggling a lot of moving-related stress (selling a home, staging).
